name: Army of the Trees
text: The Army of the Trees is the name of a poem of the creation of the year. The title of the work is the band of the trees, and it tells of the fight of the wood. In the poem the wood rises like a band of men to make war on the lord of the land. The poem of the field is one of the great pieces of the old Welsh books.

attributes.attribute: poem of the wood that rises to the fight
